title: Procedure Allowance Schedule for Rental Vehicle Coordination Network Courtesy Days
content:
**Schedule.** In working out network courtesy days on a Rental Vehicle Coordination rental, the procedure allowance is deducted from the lost calibration days. The procedure allowance follows the manufacturer procedure recorded on the calibration order: a static and dynamic procedure takes 3 days, a dynamic procedure takes 2 days, and any other procedure takes 1 day.

## Records read

The manufacturer procedure on the calibration order under ADAS Sensor Calibrations opened for the insurance claim repair order the rental is for.

## Allowance by procedure

| Manufacturer procedure on the calibration order | Procedure allowance |
|---|---|
| Static and dynamic | 3 days |
| Dynamic | 2 days |
| Static, or any other procedure | 1 day |

## Hypothetical cases

- 7 lost calibration days on an order whose manufacturer procedure is recorded as static and dynamic: 3 allowance days are deducted, leaving 4.
- The same 7 days on an order recorded as dynamic: 2 allowance days, leaving 5.
- The same 7 days on an order recorded as static: 1 allowance day, leaving 6.
